about_the_game:
NBA 2K26 Season 2 MyTEAM Bonus Offer includes the following items:

• 120 Minute 2XP Coin (MT)

• 90+ OVR Player Pack (UA)

• 10,000 MTP

• 75,000 VC

*NBA 2K Account required. One redemption per NBA 2K Account. Offer Ends: November 28th, 2025 7:59AM PT. Terms Apply.

**Both the Pro Pass and Hall of Fame Pass can be purchased directly from the Season Rewards menu. Pro Pass and Hall of Fame Pass not available in South Korea.
